title: Vasaloppet Aerobic Base Building - Ski Erg Focus

items.name: Cat-Cow
items.cues: Move slowly with controlled breathing. Link each breath to movement. Focus on spinal mobility and warming core.

items.name: 90/90 Hip Switches
items.cues: Controlled transitions between sides. Keep chest upright. This prepares hip mobility for ski movement patterns.

items.name: Band Pullaparts
items.cues: Use light resistance band. Pull apart with straight arms at chest height. Activates shoulder stability for skiing.

items.name: Air Bike
items.cues: Easy spin to elevate heart rate. RPE 2-3. Focus on smooth rhythm and breathing pattern.

items.name: Ski Erg
items.cues: Steady aerobic effort at RPE 5-6. Maintain consistent power output. Think about ski stride rhythm: drive with legs and core, pull with upper body. Target 22-26 watts (adjust based on monitor). This is your primary Vasaloppet-specific training.

items.name: Rowing Machine
items.cues: Moderate aerobic pace, RPE 5. Focus on leg drive (60%) and upper body finish (40%). Maintain steady cadence around 22-24 strokes per minute. This builds complementary endurance capacity.

items.name: Air Bike
items.cues: Easy cool-down pace, RPE 3-4. Light spinning to transition toward cooldown. Keep cadence steady around 70-80 RPM.

items.name: Calf Stretch
items.cues: Hold each side 30 seconds. Lean into the stretch gently. Important for ski-specific calf engagement recovery.

items.name: Biceps Wall Stretch
items.cues: Hold each side 30 seconds with arm at 90 degrees. Gently rotate chest away. Opens shoulders after pulling movements.

items.name: Cat-Cow
items.cues: Slow, controlled spinal articulation. Breathe deeply. Promotes parasympathetic activation and core recovery.

items.name: Adductor Rockbacks
items.cues: Gentle rockback to each side. Hold 2-3 seconds in the deep position. Recovers hip adductors used in skiing.

rationale: Vasaloppet is a 90km classic cross-country ski race requiring exceptional aerobic capacity; ski erg training directly mimics sport-specific movement patterns and builds the endurance foundation needed in 53 days.
Progressing from 55min to 65min endurance work maintains progressive overload while keeping intensity at RPE 5-6 (conversation-pace aerobic zone) for sustainable adaptation without excessive fatigue.

Multi-modal endurance approach (ski erg + rowing + bike) builds cardiovascular resilience while varying muscle recruitment patterns to prevent overuse injury and maintain training enthusiasm during pre-competition phase.
